purpose: Obtain a real current-source musl Hepta CLI build and exact-product process receipt; this is not an existing pass or complete musl business qualification.
events: workflow_dispatch on the selected workflow ref
source_contract: Checkout github.sha explicitly. PR head and actual checkout/merge are recorded separately.
Record real Git object parents from git cat-file -p HEAD headers; shallow checkout does not invent zero parents.
Record current commit/tree, source-input blobs, workflow identity, runner/kernel/image, and tracked source cleanliness before/after.
A later product commit incorporating this workflow is qualified by its own actual checkout SHA/tree, not automatically by ff72.

execution_contract.build: python3 .github/scripts/run_bazel_with_buildbuddy.py build <common options> --build_metadata=COMMIT_SHA=<actual checkout> --build_metadata=REPO_URL=https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci --build_metadata=TAG_workflow=hepta-musl-product-smoke --build_event_json_file=<job temporary file> //codex-rs/cli:hepta_linux_amd64_musl
execution_contract.platform_cquery: Same common options; query the explicit platform alias with --starlark:expr=str(target.label), without restricting its universe to the product. Require one result and record the resolved canonical label.
execution_contract.product_cqueries: Same common options and --universe_scope=//codex-rs/cli:hepta_linux_amd64_musl; query outer wrapper and inner //codex-rs/cli:hepta separately. Obtain label, build_options platforms and DefaultInfo.files_to_run.executable.path.
configured_target_checks: Main repository label exact, accepting only //... or @@//...
Both platforms exactly equal the actually resolved platform label, no guessed canonical repo regex
Resolved execution root inside actual Bazel output_base
Wrapper and inner samefile; inner actual executable resolves within that execution root
byte_and_elf_checks: Copy the configured executable, preserve executable mode, compare exact SHA256
ELF64 little endian, x86_64 machine 62, executable or PIE
Record full file/readelf outputs; reject PT_INTERP or DT_NEEDED for this static-musl qualification
Hash before each smoke, after each smoke and at terminal artifact collection

smokes.expect: exit 0 and original 'Hepta CLI' / 'Usage: hepta ' output

execution_contract.product_home: Existing HEPTA_HOME override to a job-temporary empty directory; not uploaded, no fabricated trusted attachment/signature.
execution_contract.credential_scope: Existing BuildBuddy key used only by the Bazel steps/final text redaction; removed from smoke child environment.
execution_contract.build_cache: Existing remote/local cache settings are retained. Receipt does not claim fresh full recompilation; build stdout/stderr and safe BEP metrics describe actual cache use.

contents: receipt.json with per-command argv, return code, elapsed, timeout/attempt and exact executed binary hash
full build stdout/stderr with literal BuildBuddy key redacted if present
safe BEP event/metric projection and raw input SHA256, with raw options/client environment/command lines excluded
evidence.partial_failure: No retry, skip-success or pass manufacture. Job failure/step timeout retains whatever receipt/logs were actually written if finalization succeeds. Cancellation or failed safe finalization may leave only original GitHub job logs.

acceptance_after_actual_run: Workflow/job terminal success, exact expected commit or explicitly tree-equal synthetic merge, no source changes.
Inspect per-command receipt: exactly one successful build, one successful version and one successful help; no timeout/retry.
Inspect resolved canonical target platform and both configured executable identities.
Independently download artifact, verify GitHub ZIP size/digest/CRC and per-member manifest; compare actual ELF bytes/hash to both executed-smoke hashes.
Read original logs and cache metrics; retain cache hits as cache-backed build, never as a fresh compiler run.
Close only the explicit static-musl CLI build/process gap. Full integration/behavior, sandbox/security, networking, Alpine deployment and ARM musl remain separate gates.

source_evidence.meaning: Defines codex and hepta multiplatform binaries; the selected Hepta musl target already exists.
platform_data maps the existing target to @llvm//platforms:linux_amd64_musl; it is tagged manual.
The inner target is a real rust_binary with CARGO_BIN_NAME=hepta and the existing stamped source identity.
Pins LLVM 0.8.11, rules_platform 0.1.0, rules_rs 0.0.96 and Rust 1.95.0; registers the existing toolchain and both Linux musl target triples.
GNU/glibc local Linux execution platform remains necessary for host-loaded proc macros; the existing RBE alias remains unchanged.
ci-linux defaults the outer platform to RBE and ci enables remote_download_minimal. The new explicit per-command platform and download_toplevel follow these configs; no existing config is edited.

Reuses existing authenticated remote configuration or keyless fallback and startup/cache settings. Explicit ci is retained when keyless fallback removes ci-linux. No credentials are copied to new stores.
Existing setup/repository-cache restoration; target input is a setup/cache namespace, not the proof of target compilation.
Existing Bazelisk 1.28.1 and setup-ci are reused.
Existing hosted-runner tools/build paths; no new platform installation or Cargo lane.
Existing repository precedent uses the same Python wrapper for cquery output resolution and bazel info execution_root/output_base.
The Hepta entry uses the common real CLI, product_name/version, 'Hepta CLI' and 'Usage: hepta' help contract.
HEPTA_HOME is the existing supported product-home override. The smoke uses a job-temporary empty home, does not change HOME/CODEX_HOME or create authority inputs.

upstream_api_evidence.meaning: Transitions target platform; DefaultInfo has an executable symlink and transitive original binary files, so choosing first --output=files entry would be unsound.
Existing libc-aware platform declarations provide musl constraints.
Primary API documents providers(target), build_options(target), --universe_scope, configured-target ambiguity and executable file paths relative to execroot.

validation.independent_architecture_v1_api_review: Read full v1 plus Bazel 9.3.0 API; requested exact labels and output-root anchoring, incorporated.
validation.root_v1_review: Requested raw commit parent headers and actual resolved platform identity; both incorporated. Final publication approval remains root-owned.
limitations: Actual registered-toolchain resolution, product link, hosted-runner inspection-tool availability and process behavior remain unqualified until the workflow executes.
The source comment about Linux cross-build/libc complexity is not ignored; genuine analysis/link failure is retained, without changing libraries, platform definitions or filters to obtain green.
New workflow budgets apply only to this new qualification; no original timeout/assertion/required job is modified.

independent_architecture_final_review.basis: Complete final candidate and pinned Bazel 9.3.0 provider/Label Java sources read; no execution.
